LanguageData.RimatomicsPlusPlus.NukesIgnoreHeavyWeapo: You can't launch transport pods at a location with heavy weapons systems.\nAn ICBM would also get shot down, right?
LanguageData.RimatomicsPlusPlus.SettlementDestruction: Destroying a faction's settlement gives you +20 goodwill with every faction that is hostile to them.\nNuking settlements is generally easier, so should give less goodwill.
LanguageData.RimatomicsPlusPlus.FalloutInSpace.Label: Nuclear fallout in space
LanguageData.RimatomicsPlusPlus.FalloutInSpace.Descri: High-yield nuclear detonations usually spread fallout to the surrounding tiles.\nDoesn't really make sense for that to happen in the vacuum of space though...
LanguageData.RimatomicsPlusPlus.Patches.Label: Patches
LanguageData.RimatomicsPlusPlus.Patches.Description: Changing any of these will require a restart, hover over each one for more details.
LanguageData.RimatomicsPlusPlus.LaunchPadTargeting.De:
Overhauls world tile targeting logic and UI for strategic missile launches.

When Disabled:
- Targeting tiles on different layers will not work.
- Looking at far away tiles will cause noticeable frame drops even when the guidance system upgrade is unlocked.
- The "nukes ignore heavy weapons systems" setting will not do anything.
LanguageData.RimatomicsPlusPlus.RailgunTargeting.Desc:
Overhauls world tile targeting logic and UI for fire missions.

When Disabled:
- Targeting tiles on different layers will not work.
- The ABOS upgrade will not allow Punishers to fire mission their own map.
- The EEPA upgrade will not impact maximum fire mission range.
- The ABOS and EEPA upgrades will not impact pulse size.
LanguageData.RimatomicsPlusPlus.RadiationWarnings.Des: Suppresses the console warning spam that occurs when a pawn is irradiated.
LanguageData.RimatomicsPlusPlus.NukeWorldObject.Label: ICBM world object (BaseMissile.Tick)
LanguageData.RimatomicsPlusPlus.NukeWorldObject.Descr:
Replaces the strategic missile world object with a custom one.

When Disabled:
- Targeting tiles on different layers will not work.
- The afterburners upgrade will not do anything.
- The "settlement destruction goodwill gain" and "nuclear fallout in space" settings will not do anything.
LanguageData.RimatomicsPlusPlus.SabotWorldObject.Desc:
Replaces the sabot world object with a custom one.

When Disabled:
- Targeting tiles on different layers will not work.
- The ABOS upgrade will not impact sabot world travel speed.
LanguageData.RimatomicsPlusPlus.BatteryAlert.Label: Need batteries alert (Alert_NeedBatteries.NeedBatteries)
LanguageData.RimatomicsPlusPlus.BatteryAlert.Descript: Stops the "need batteries" alert from appearing if you have PPCs or similar buildings.
LanguageData.RimatomicsPlusPlus.NukeCellFlash.Label: Nuclear explosion cell flashes (NuclearStrike.Flash)
LanguageData.RimatomicsPlusPlus.NukeCellFlash.Descrip: Fixes errors caused by nuclear explosions trying to update terrain on out-of-bounds cells.
LanguageData.RimatomicsPlusPlus.RailgunSpread.Label: Punisher spread (Building_Railgun.spread)
LanguageData.RimatomicsPlusPlus.RailgunSpread.Descrip: Adds buttons for adjusting fire mission spread on Punishers with the targeting chip upgrade.
LanguageData.RimatomicsPlusPlus.RailgunLOS.Label: Punisher line of sight (Verb_Railgun.CanHitCellFromCellIgnoringRange)
LanguageData.RimatomicsPlusPlus.RailgunLOS.Descriptio: Enables firing without line of sight when the ABOS upgrade is installed.
LanguageData.RimatomicsPlusPlus.FuelRodUI.Label: Fuel rod UI (Dialog_ReactorConsole.drawSlot)
LanguageData.RimatomicsPlusPlus.FuelRodUI.Description: Fixes text wrapping issues when displaying fuel rod power in the reactor control UI.
Adds information about what is currently being researched in the inspect pane of Rimatomics research benches.
LanguageData.RimatomicsPlusPlus.NukeFalloutMultiplaye: Fixes potential desyncs caused by non-deterministic RNG related to the duration of fallout caused by high yield nuclear explosions.
LanguageData.RimatomicsPlusPlus.EnergyWeaponBurstMult: Fixes potential desyncs caused by this method. I'm not sure how nor why this method is desyncing, but hopefully this fixes it...
LanguageData.RimatomicsPlusPlus.ReactorManMultiplayer: Fixes desyncs caused by opening the reactor UI with a pawn instead of directly. This will also change the setting in Rimatomics.
Fixes desyncs caused by changing nuclear missile yields.
LanguageData.RimatomicsPlusPlus.WeaponsBenchMultiplay: Fixes potential desyncs caused by randomly-generated laser VFX positioning on weapons benches.
LanguageData.RimatomicsPlusPlus.Research.Label: Rimatomics research project (XML)
LanguageData.RimatomicsPlusPlus.Research.Description: Moves the Rimatomics research project to the main tab and adjusts its cost to 1000.
LanguageData.RimatomicsPlusPlus.FatalRad.Label: Fatal radiation exposure (XML)
LanguageData.RimatomicsPlusPlus.FatalRad.Description: Removes the stage labels of the fatal radiation exposure (i.e. acute radiation syndome) hediff.\n\nThis option is only really here to disable if a translation is breaking.
LanguageData.RimatomicsPlusPlus.Ordering.Label: UI ordering (XML)
LanguageData.RimatomicsPlusPlus.Ordering.Description: Tweaks the UI ordering of all the buildings in the Rimatomics tab of the architect menu.
LanguageData.RimatomicsPlusPlus.PipeDeconstruct.Label: Deconstruct pipes button (XML)
LanguageData.RimatomicsPlusPlus.PipeDeconstruct.Descr: Removes the "Deconstruct Pipes" button from the Rimatomics architect tab.
